missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.control: P6 same-input / same-RNG zero-change control and paired Gaussian-Gumbel state restore
missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.consequence: P6 is registered as order_effect_not_identified. The 0.0235 mean-max risk difference CANNOT be attributed to patch order.
missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.minimum_followup: One extra eval-only pass per patient that restores Python/NumPy/Torch CPU/CUDA RNG state immediately before both the baseline and the permuted forward, plus an identical-input/identical-RNG zero-change arm. This is a diagnostic re-run, NOT a new training run, but it still requires separate execution authorisation.

missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.control: P2 full distribution over the 28 distinct unordered slot pairs per patient
missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.status: partial - the artifact reports per-patient MAX off-diagonal cosine and a full-matrix count above 0.95
missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.consequence: 'at least one high-similarity pair per patient' cannot be upgraded to 'all 8 slots are duplicates'.
missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.minimum_followup: Record all 28 pairwise cosines plus slot norms per patient.

missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.control: P4 full-model slot permutation through the selector and keep path
missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.status: absent - only the mean over slots was permuted
missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.consequence: P4 remains a mathematical sanity check. It cannot support 'slot semantics drift' or any harm claim.
missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.minimum_followup: Forward the model with a synchronised slot-index permutation applied before the top-k selection and report logit/risk differences.

missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.control: risk direction validation C(risk) vs C(-risk) with matched censoring rules
missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.consequence: The sign convention of the reported C-index is unverified; exploratory risk/time Spearman is not a substitute.
missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.minimum_followup: Compute both C(risk) and C(-risk) on the same patients with the same comparable-pair rule.

missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.status: absent - the loader opportunity counts are recorded (1 missing endpoint/WSI string, 1 fewer real patches) but all probes use CONTROLLED zero rows, not real irrelevant tissue
missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.consequence: The logit/risk sensitivity is real for synthetic zeros; its clinical relevance is unestablished.
missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.minimum_followup: Quantify how often real cohorts contain fewer patches than the configured budget.

missing_controls_that_no_existing_artifa.consequence: P7 scope is limited to the 8 pred_keep_slot parameters.
